name: AWS Certified benefit: 50% off your next exam
certifications: Any AWS Certification exam, including recertification
requirements: Hold an active AWS Certification. The discount voucher appears among the benefits in your AWS Certification account.
verificationNote: AWS Certification benefits page: "Get access to a 50% discount voucher to apply toward recertification or any other exam." AWS store on Pearson VUE lists list prices of USD 100 foundational, USD 150 associate, USD 300 professional and specialty.
notes: Only open to people who have already passed (and paid for) an AWS exam, hence purchase-first. The page does not say how long the voucher stays valid.
why: AWS's own benefits page states the 50% voucher and that it applies to any exam. A standing benefit, not a campaign, so it never expires off the site. Added by hand on 2026-10-03.

name: Juniper Open Learning: 75% off certification exams

cost: 25% of the exam fee: USD 50 associate (regularly 200), USD 75 specialist (regularly 300), USD 100 professional (regularly 400)
requirements: Complete all modules of the free Open Learning course and pass its Voucher Assessment Test with 70% or higher. The Pearson VUE voucher is valid for 30 days, so schedule and sit the exam inside that window.
verificationNote: Juniper learning portal page "Get Started with Free HPE Networking Training": 75% discount, associate USD 50 (regularly 200), specialist 75 (regularly 300), professional 100 (regularly 400); "Complete all the course modules and pass the Voucher Assessment Test with a score of 70% or higher". The JNCIA-Junos course page shows cost "$0 USD" and "The voucher code is only valid for a maximum of 30 days."

why: The vendor's own portal states the free course, the 75% voucher, the prices and the 70% assessment rule. Standing programme with no end date. Added by hand on 2026-10-03.

name: Salesforce Partner Program certification vouchers
